title: Northgate Store and Online Orders: Installation Crew Standby Amount
content:
**Late-change goodwill standby amount for the installation crew.** On the late-change goodwill refund of a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order of **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, a flat amount is given counting the major appliance units on the order:

| Major appliance units on the order | Standby amount |
|---|---|
| two or more | two dollars fifty (2.50) for each unit |
| exactly one | a flat four dollars (4.00) |
| none | nothing |

**Hypothetical orders.** Three appliance units give 7.50, being 2.50 multiplied by 3; two give 5.00; one gives 4.00.
